assertion_results.text: Bug parsing extracts the Environment / Version section content including the vague text (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: In bug-parsing.md, the 'Environment / Version' section under 'Parsed Required Sections' contains: '> Not sure which version — using whatever is deployed on staging.' followed by a note: 'This section contains vague, non-specific text. No version number or recognizable version pattern (e.g., `0.9.0`, `ACME 2.1.0`) can be extracted.' The vague text is explicitly extracted and reproduced verbatim.

assertion_results.text: Version resolution determines that no version identifier can be extracted from the vague description (Step 4.5.2)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, sub-step 4.5.2 shows a pattern search table where all patterns (bare version number, product-prefixed version, version keyword + number, named release) are marked 'No'. The result states: 'No version pattern found. The text "Not sure which version — using whatever is deployed on staging" is entirely vague — it explicitly states the reporter does not know the version and provides no numeric or named identifier.' Decision: 'Cannot extract a version. Skip sub-steps 4.5.3, 4.5.4, and 4.5.5.'

assertion_results.text: Version resolution outputs the gap comment: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, sub-step 4.5.6 contains a code block with the exact text: 'Affects Version could not be determined from the bug description — please set manually.' This matches the required gap comment verbatim.

assertion_results.text: The gap comment includes the Comment Footnote (Step 4.5.6)
assertion_results.evidence: In version-resolution.md, sub-step 4.5.6, immediately after the comment code block, the output states: '(Comment would include the `sdlc-workflow/triage-bug` ADF footnote.)' This explicitly confirms the gap comment would include the Comment Footnote.
